{"schema_version":1,"triplet_id":"ft_mp_parse_787468773c9f","entrypoint":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","input_strategy":{"description":"Decode the fuzz input as a bounded sequence of MP frames. Each frame is assembled by the harness from fuzz bytes: the 8-byte header is built with fixed magic 'M','P', version 1, a fuzzer-selected opcode, and harness-computed payload_length and checksum; the payload bytes come directly from the fuzz input. Each assembled frame is passed to mp_parse on the same mp_context, which stays alive across all frames in the iteration.","data_identifier":"data","size_identifier":"size","bounded_steps":32,"notes":["Frame header is 8 bytes (MP_HEADER_SIZE); payload offset is 8.","payload_length is repaired by the harness to equal the actual payload byte count for the frame and must be <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD.","checksum is repaired by the harness using mp_checksum over the payload and written little-endian at offset 6.","Opcode byte at offset 3 is taken from fuzz input and selects among MP_READ, MP_WRITE, MP_MULTIPLY, MP_STORE, MP_USE, MP_RELEASE, and one additional case.","Payload bytes from offset 8 up to MP_MAX_PAYLOAD are fuzzer-controlled and never filled with constants.","Loop stops when remaining fuzz bytes cannot form another frame or the 32-step cap is reached."]},"state_objects":[{"name":"ctx","type":"mp_context","initialization":"mp_init(&ctx) at the start of LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput; kept alive across all frames in the iteration and destroyed once at the end via mp_destroy(&ctx)."}],"call_sequence":[{"function":"mp_init","roles":["HPF"],"purpose":"Initialize the mp_context once per libFuzzer iteration so it can carry state (saved, saved_len, owns_saved, observation) across all frames decoded from the fuzz input.","arguments":["&ctx"],"uses_fuzzer_data":false,"uses_fuzzer_size":false,"outputs":["ctx initialized"],"conditions":["called once at the start of LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput"]},{"function":"mp_parse","roles":["ISF","PRF"],"purpose":"Parse one assembled MP frame per call. The harness assembles each frame from fuzz bytes (opcode and payload from fuzz input; magic, version, payload_length and checksum repaired by the harness) and invokes mp_parse repeatedly on the same ctx so stateful opcodes such as MP_STORE, MP_USE and MP_RELEASE observe state left by earlier frames. mp_parse is also the PRF and is responsible for the per-frame parse; cleanup of ctx is handled by mp_destroy after the loop.","arguments":["&ctx","frame_bytes","frame_len"],"uses_fuzzer_data":true,"uses_fuzzer_size":true,"outputs":["int return status per frame","ctx->saved / ctx->saved_len / ctx->owns_saved / ctx->observation mutations"],"conditions":["frame_len >= MP_HEADER_SIZE","payload_length == frame_len - MP_HEADER_SIZE","payload_length <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","checksum matches mp_checksum(payload, payload_length)","loop bounded by 32 steps and remaining fuzz bytes"]}],"cleanup_sequence":[{"function":"mp_destroy","purpose":"Release any resources owned by ctx (e.g. ctx->saved when ctx->owns_saved is set) after all frames have been processed. Runs once per iteration, after the bounded multi-frame loop completes.","arguments":["&ctx"],"after":["mp_parse"]}],"constraints":["mp_parse must be called with a non-NULL ctx and non-NULL data pointer.","Each frame passed to mp_parse must satisfy size >= MP_HEADER_SIZE (8).","payload_length field at offset 4 (little-endian, width 2) must equal size - MP_HEADER_SIZE and must be <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD.","checksum field at offset 6 (little-endian, width 2) must equal mp_checksum(data + MP_HEADER_SIZE, payload_length).","Header bytes at offsets 0,1,2 must be 'M','P',1 respectively.","Opcode byte at offset 3 is fuzzer-controlled and selects the dispatch case.","Payload bytes from offset 8 up to MP_MAX_PAYLOAD are fuzzer-controlled and must not be replaced with constants.","The mp_context must remain alive across all frames within one LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call and be destroyed exactly once at the end.","The multi-frame loop must be bounded by 32 steps."],"notes":["mp_parse is both ISF and PRF; it appears once in call_sequence and its cleanup responsibility is delegated to mp_destroy in cleanup_sequence.","mp_destroy is HPF and appears only in cleanup_sequence, after the loop.","mp_init is HPF and appears in call_sequence before mp_parse.","No project APIs are invented; only mp_init, mp_parse, mp_destroy, le16 and mp_checksum are referenced, matching the contract helpers."],"protocol_contract_bindings":{"context":{"destroy":"mp_destroy","init":"mp_init","lifetime":"per_iteration","type":"mp_context"},"frame":{"fields":[{"name":"magic0","offset":0,"role":"magic","value":"'M'","width":1},{"name":"magic1","offset":1,"role":"magic","value":"'P'","width":1},{"name":"version","offset":2,"role":"version","value":"1","width":1},{"name":"opcode","offset":3,"role":"opcode","width":1},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"payload_length","offset":4,"role":"payload_length","width":2},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"checksum","offset":6,"role":"checksum","width":2},{"name":"payload","offset":8,"role":"payload","width":"payload_length"}],"header_size":8,"max_payload":64,"max_payload_symbol":"MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","payload_offset":8},"helpers":["le16","mp_checksum","mp_destroy","mp_init","mp_parse"],"input_model":{"bounded_multi_frame":true,"bounded_steps":32,"bounded_steps_source":"engineering_choice","payload_fuzzer_controlled":true,"repair_checksum":true,"repair_length":true},"stateful_operations":["MP_RELEASE","MP_STORE","MP_USE"]}}
